"""Check exact source/copy bindings, continued states, all tables and native pixels."""

import ast
import copy
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from PIL import Image
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from v175_postprocess import REPO, ROOT, context, read, ref, source, write_once

from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail

plan, post = context()
output = REPO / "docs/results/v175-fresh-noise-matching-publication-verification-v1.json"
assert not output.exists()
index = REPO / "docs/results/v175-fresh-noise-matching-final-v1.json"
final = read(index)
for key in ["preparation", "CPU_readiness", "postprocess_preparation", "initial_prefix_audit", "canonical_V172_scores", "V161_current_metrics", "sources", "figures", "report"]:
    assert ref(final[key]["path"]) == final[key]
for copies in final["copies"].values():
    for binding in copies.values():
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    assert Path(copies["original"]["path"]).read_bytes() == Path(copies["public"]["path"]).read_bytes()
preparation = read(final["preparation"]["path"])
ready = read(final["CPU_readiness"]["path"])
prepared_post = read(final["postprocess_preparation"]["path"])
bundle = read(final["sources"]["path"])
source_checks = 0
for item in preparation["source_texts"] + prepared_post["source_texts"] + bundle["additional_sources"]:
    assert ref(item["path"])["sha256"] == item["sha256"] and Path(item["path"]).read_text() == item["text"]
    source_checks += 1
for name, digest in plan["prior_neural_hashes"].items():
    assert ref(REPO / "src/demosaic" / name)["sha256"] == digest
assert len(plan["prior_neural_hashes"]) == 96
assert "54 passed" in ready["CPU_tests"]["text"] and ready["readiness"]["contents"]["new_neural_forwards"] == 0
assert ready["readiness"]["contents"]["runner"] == plan["runner"]


def functions(path):
    return {n.name: ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False) for n in ast.parse(Path(path).read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}


reference = read(plan["reference_V172_plan"]["path"])
spread = read(plan["spread_scores"]["path"])
spread_plan = read(spread["plan"]["path"])
prior_functions, current_functions = functions(spread_plan["runner"]["path"]), functions(plan["runner"]["path"])
assert all(prior_functions[key] == current_functions[key] for key in ["resources", "runtime", "tree_equal"])
assert prior_functions["review"].replace("V174-", "V175-") == current_functions["review"]
assert ref(Path(reference["work"]) / "scripts/nonlocal_residual_objective.py")["sha256"] == ref(Path(plan["work"]) / "scripts/nonlocal_residual_objective.py")["sha256"]
assert 'method = f"V175-{endpoint}"' in Path(plan["runner"]["path"]).read_text()
initial = torch.load(plan["initial_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
assert initial["updates"] == 900 and len(initial["optimizer"]["state"]) == 141
assert all(float(state["step"]) == 900 for state in initial["optimizer"]["state"].values())
module = LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan["module_config"])
module.load_state_dict(initial["models"], strict=True)
assert model_hash(module) == plan["initial_module_hashes"]["raw"]
module.network.load_state_dict(initial["ema"], strict=True)
assert model_hash(module) == plan["initial_module_hashes"]["EMA"]

canonical = read(post["canonical_V172_scores"]["path"])
original = read(plan["baseline_scores"]["path"])
roundtrip = copy.deepcopy(canonical)
for row in roundtrip["rows"] + roundtrip["summary"]:
    row["method"] = row["method"].replace("V172-", "V171-")
for key, value in roundtrip["native_predictions"].items():
    roundtrip["native_predictions"][key] = {label.replace("V172-", "V171-"): binding for label, binding in value.items()}
assert roundtrip == original
detail = read(post["V161_current_metrics"]["path"])
assert detail["design"] == plan["design"] and detail["metric_sources"] == plan["metrics_sources"]
assert len(detail["rows"]) == 822 and detail["maximum_original_scalar_difference"] == 0
for row in detail["rows"]:
    assert ref(row["prediction"]["path"]) == row["prediction"]

for endpoint, binding in final["checkpoints"].items():
    assert ref(binding["export"]["path"]) == binding["export"]
    state = torch.load(binding["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    module = LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**state["module_config"])
    module.load_state_dict(state["state_dict"], strict=True)
    assert state["component"] == "LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail" and model_hash(module) == binding["module_hash"]
    assert model_hash(module.frozen) == binding["frozen_module_hash"]
    assert len(module.state_dict()) == 188 and len(module.network.state_dict()) == 141
    assert sum(p.numel() for p in module.network.parameters()) == 2088906
    assert state["step"] == 10000 and state["actual_optimizer_updates"] == 9000 and state["new_optimizer_updates"] == 8100
    assert state["continuation_training"]["initial_checkpoint"] == plan["initial_checkpoint"]
    assert state["continuation_training"]["fresh_sensor_batches"] == 8073
    assert ref(state["source"]["path"]) == state["source"]

paired = read(ROOT / "paired-comparisons-v1.json")
summary = {(row["kind"], row["condition"], row["cohort"], row["method"]): row for row in paired["summary"]}
assert paired["methods"] == 9 and paired["actual_metric_rows"] == 7398
bindings = read(ROOT / "report-bindings-v1.json")
report = REPO / "docs/fresh-noise-matching.md"
text = report.read_text()
assert ref(report) == bindings["report"] == final["report"] and len(bindings["cells"]) == 378
for cell in bindings["cells"]:
    row = summary[cell["kind"], cell["condition"], cell["cohort"], cell["method"]]
    assert f"{row[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}" == cell["rendered"]
for line in bindings["lines"]:
    assert line in text

native = read(final["figures"]["path"])
assert len(native["images"]) == 60 and sum(item["triplet"] for item in native["images"]) == 12
prior = read(plan["prior_figures"]["path"])
old_map = {item["image"]["path"]: item for item in prior["images"]}
new_channels = copied_channels = 0
for item in native["images"]:
    old = old_map[item["source_figure"]["path"]]
    assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"] and item["source_figure"] == old["image"] and item["no_resize"]
    assert Path(item["image"]["path"]).read_bytes() == Path(item["original_image"]["path"]).read_bytes()
    for field in ["ROI_xywh", "anchor", "contrast", "exposure"]:
        assert item[field] == old[field]
    image = np.asarray(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]))
    old_image = np.asarray(Image.open(old["image"]["path"]))
    arrays = dict(np.load(item["case"]["arrays"]["path"]))
    anchor = np.asarray(item["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
    old_panels = {panel["label"]: panel for panel in old["panels"]}
    for panel in item["panels"]:
        label = panel["label"]
        x, y, width, height = panel["xywh"]
        assert width == height == 160
        if label in item["predictions"]:
            binding = item["predictions"][label]
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            value = np.load(binding["path"])
            expected = independent_display(anchor + item["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor), arrays, item["ROI_xywh"], item["exposure"])
            new_channels += expected.size
        else:
            px, py, pw, ph = old_panels[label]["xywh"]
            expected = old_image[py:py + ph, px:px + pw]
            copied_channels += expected.size
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y + height, x:x + width], expected)
assert new_channels == 8294400 and copied_channels == 32332800
viewing = read(ROOT / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json")
assert viewing["native_figures"] == 60 and sorted(viewing["indices"]) == list(range(60))
assert ref(viewing["journal"]["path"]) == viewing["journal"]
browser = read(REPO / "docs/results/v175-native-viewer-verification-v1.json")
assert browser["cases"] == 48 and browser["native_panels"] == 240 and browser["screen_RGB_channels_exact"] == 18432000
assert browser["JS_errors"] == [] and browser["click_and_keyboard_flip_pass"] and browser["next_previous_wrap_pass"]
assert ref(browser["viewer"]["path"]) == browser["viewer"] and ref(browser["source_manifest"]["path"]) == browser["source_manifest"] == final["figures"]

execution = read(ROOT / "execution-completion-v1.json")
assert execution["total_new_candidate_matching_CUDA_calls"] == 9600 and execution["total_new_full_parent_CUDA_calls"] == 8075
assert execution["total_frozen_component_CUDA_calls"] == 9744 and execution["repeated_scientific_prefix_calls"] == 0
training = read(ROOT / "training-audit-v1.json")
assert training["continuation_rows_checked"] == 9000 and training["FP32_loss_totals_checked"] == 8100
assert training["fresh_sensor_batches"] == 8073 and training["actual_final_Adam_step"] == 9000
assert training["final_Adam_states"] == 141 and training["strict_final_raw_and_EMA_states"] == 2
assert training["saved_prefix_batches_checked"] == 7
quality = read(ROOT / "quality-audit-v1.json")
assert quality["input_fingerprints_checked"] == 6576 and quality["saved_native_RGB_checked"] == quality["saved_native_residuals_checked"] == 72
assert quality["ADC_outputs_exact_V169"] == 144
offsets = read(ROOT / "offset-audit-v1.json")
assert offsets["arrays"] == 30 and offsets["bytes"] == 102780672
for observation in offsets["observations"]:
    for block in observation["blocks"]:
        assert ref(block["array"]["path"]) == block["array"]
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
diary = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
assert diary.is_relative_to(REPO / "diary") and diary.is_file()
documents = [REPO / name for name in ["README.md", "docs/index.md", "docs/current-model.md", "docs/research.md", "docs/experiments.md", "docs/fresh-noise-matching.md"]] + [diary]
links = 0
for path in documents:
    for target in re.findall(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)", path.read_text()):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):
            continue
        resolved = (path.parent / target.split("#")[0]).resolve()
        assert resolved == output or resolved.is_file(), (path, target)
        links += 1
write_once(output, dict(status="pass-exact-copies-sources-continuation-endpoints-tables-native-browser-pixels-and-links",
    publication=ref(index), exact_copies=len(final["copies"]), source_texts_checked=source_checks, unchanged_prior_neural_files=96,
    strict_full_state_endpoint_loads=2, unchanged_runtime_restoration_function_ASTs=3, review_function_AST_only_method_labels_changed=True,
    strict_initial_V172_Adam_step=900, actual_final_Adam_step=9000, V172_label_view_roundtrip_exact=True,
    old_V161_array_bindings_checked=822, rounded_table_cells=378, native_figures=60, native_triplets=12,
    new_RGB_channels_recomputed=new_channels, unchanged_RGB_channels_compared=copied_channels,
    browser_RGB_channels_exact=18432000, saved_offset_tensors_checked=30, document_links_checked=links,
    documents={str(path): ref(path) for path in documents}, new_neural_forwards=0, new_sensor_noise_draws=0,
    CUDA_initialized=False, source=source(__file__), scope=quality["scope"]))
print("PASS", len(final["copies"]), "exact copies;378 cells;60 native figures;", new_channels + copied_channels, "RGB channels;", links, "links")
